samples.xml_description: Implement a traffic light with pedestrian button. Reset signal (active low). Clock signal. Request signal for allowing vehicles to pass. Red light output. Yellow light output. Green light output. 0 1 2 3 cnt is a sequential logic. If rst_n is deactive, cnt is 10 decimal. Otherwise, if pass_request is active and green is active and cnt is greater than 10, cnt is 10 decimal. Otherwise, if green is deactive and p_green is active, cnt is 60 decimal. Otherwise, if yellow is deactive and p_yellow is active, cnt is 5 decimal. Otherwise, if red is deactive and p_red is active, cnt is 10 decimal. Otherwise, cnt is decremented by 1 on every positive edge of the clock. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (~rst_n) begin cnt <= 8'd10; end else begin if (pass_request && green && cnt > 8'd10) cnt <= 8'd10; else if (~green && p_green) cnt <= 8'd60; else if (~yellow && p_yellow) cnt <= 8'd5; else if (~red && p_red) cnt <= 8'd10; else cnt <= cnt - 1; end end state is a sequential logic. If rst_n is deactive, state is idle. Otherwise, in case state is idle, state is s1_red. In case state is s1_red, if cnt is counts to 3 decimal, state is s3_green, else state is s1_red. In case state is s2_yellow, if cnt is counts to 3 decimal, state is s1_red, else state is s2_yellow. In case state is s3_green, if cnt is counts to 3 decimal, state is s2_yellow, else state is s3_green. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (~rst_n) state <= idle; else begin case (state) idle: state <= s1_red; s1_red: begin if (cnt == 3) state <= s3_green; else state <= s1_red; end s2_yellow: begin if (cnt == 3) state <= s1_red; else state <= s2_yellow; end s3_green: begin if (cnt == 3) state <= s2_yellow; else state <= s3_green; end default: state <= idle; endcase end end p_red, p_green, p_yellow is a sequential logic. If rst_n is deactive, p_red, p_green, and p_yellow is reset to 0. Otherwise, red is set to 1 if state is s1_red, yellow is set to 1 if state is s2_yellow, and green is set to 1 if state is s3_green. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (~rst_n) begin p_red <= 1'b0; p_green <= 1'b0; p_yellow <= 1'b0; end else begin if (state == s1_red) p_red <= 1'b1; else if (state == s2_yellow) p_yellow <= 1'b1; else if (state == s3_green) p_green <= 1'b1; end end red, green, yellow is a sequential logic. If rst_n is deactive, red, yellow, and green is reset to 0. Otherwise, red is set to p_red, yellow is set to p_yellow, and green is set to p_green. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (~rst_n) begin red <= 1'b0; yellow <= 1'b0; green <= 1'b0; end else begin red <= p_red; yellow <= p_yellow; green <= p_green; end end Implement the traffic light logic. Initialize the internal counter cnt to 10 decimal. Initialize the state to idle. Initialize the output signals red, yellow, and green to 0. On every positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal, if the reset signal is active, update the state to the next state. On every positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal, if the reset signal is active, update the counter cnt to the next value. On every positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal, if the reset signal is active, update the output signals red, yellow, and green to the corresponding values of p_red, p_yellow, and p_green.
